name: Legal Practice, Enterprise Risk & Audit Domain Practices
description: Exhaustive business-domain knowledge pack for Legal Practice Management, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), and Internal Audit, covering legal matter intake, conflict checks, contract negotiation, risk-to-remediation, audit testing, and legal hold management.
owner: Global Legal Counsel & Enterprise Risk Governance Office

checklists.name: Legal, Enterprise Risk & Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for legal conflict checks, contract negotiations, risk assessments, and internal audit testing.

items.statement: Conflict-of-interest checks evaluate potential adverse parties prior to legal matter intake.
Contract negotiations track redline changes and non-standard clause approvals (limitation of liability, indemnities).
Legal hold notices issue to custodians automatically upon notice of pending litigation.
Enterprise Risk Register evaluates risk impact and likelihood scores with defined risk owners.
Internal audit workpapers document sample selection, control testing evidence, and finding severities.

reviewGates.name: General Counsel & Chief Risk Officer Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The General Counsel and Chief Risk Officer confirm that contract terms, litigation holds, and audit finding remediations satisfy legal requirements.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the legal & risk documentation confirm contract compliance and risk control effectiveness?
